prompts.hagen: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the existing four-frame Hagen sheet (1024x384), frame order neutral, determined, alarmed, tired. Add CLEAR visible expression-specific mouths below the nose in each face. Neutral: horizontal dark closed lips; determined: compressed firm slightly angled mouth; alarmed: dark open oval mouth with subtle lower lip; tired: downturned slack mouth. Keep EXACTLY everything else: each face identity, eyes, grey hair, armor, stance, outline, body, transparent background, four positions, chunky pixel grid. Mouths should be deliberate 4x4 pixel blocks matching existing logical pixels, dark warm brown against skin, not beards or moustaches. No new gradients, glow, smoothing, missing facial features or glossy plastic. Preserve original dimensions, frame count, alignment and alpha. Output the complete edited four-frame transparent sheet.
prompts.story_dead:
Use case: compositing / illustration-story. Create a 1920x1080 pixel-art story background for Human Last Rampart, dead beacon fortress at dusk. Inputs: image 1 real game tactical map is AUTHORITATIVE fortress footprint (square 4 continuous low stone walls, large empty flat square courtyard, NO castle keep); image 2 real battle screenshot is AUTHORITATIVE masonry, crenellations, broad wall walk, field colors and crisp pixel scale; image 3 prior story art is ONLY narrative context, its tall castle, cliffs, ruins, fog and architecture MUST BE REPLACED.
Camera: pulled-back slightly elevated oblique view of the actual simple square fortress so ALL FOUR walls and courtyard are plainly visible, with broad squat rectangular crenellations like the battle screenshot. Plain grey/blue granite squared block walls, continuous flat wall walks, simple square corners not towers, flat muted olive field outside, no mountains or cliffs. In courtyard a modest unlit beacon bowl on a SHORT plain stone plinth, not a castle tower. Few tiny distant expedition silhouettes on courtyard path, no faces, no identifiable hero costume. Dusk warm horizon light from upper left, cool shadow-facing masonry, clear block shadows. Lower third y720-1080 is calm dark muted bare field with low contrast for dialogue. Sharp deliberate chunky pixels, limited 3-step material shading. NO ornamental fantasy castle, no arches or spires, no purple/teal neon, no grey fog veil, no plastic, no watercolor, no bloom, no text or UI. Keep composition practical and sparse like the real game. Opaque 16:9 background.
prompts.story_relit: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target image 1 dead-beacon story scene. Keep EXACT same camera, all four low square fortress walls, masonry and crenellations, wall thickness, empty courtyard, flat terrain, silhouettes and composition. Relight the small CENTER courtyard beacon bowl, with a compact bright golden flame and a narrow warm vertical shaft that fades upward, not an enormous laser or white blown-out column. Time is now dark blue-black night, with restrained amber illumination on the nearest courtyard stones, strong grounded directional shadows away from bowl, still readable fortress geometry. Thin black fog only at distant horizon, parted near beacon line, NO grey foreground haze, no global bloom, no new walls or towers, no new characters, no faces, no purple/teal neon. Keep lower third calm dark muted low contrast for dialogue. Crisp pixel-art shading with same pixel density. 1920x1080 opaque image, no UI/text.
prompts.glow: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the input orange brazier light sprite into a MUCH MORE COMPACT crisp amber point-light cookie. Transparent RGBA square, 192x192 logical pixels. One centered light source. Maximum visible radius 58px, completely transparent outer 35px border. Three/four deliberate stepped alpha bands falling off from small warm amber core, not a solid opaque orange disc. No white center, no soft airbrush aura, no flame, no particles, no texture, no backdrop, no text. This overlays blue-black masonry using additive alpha at restrained brightness; should read as compact warm falloff, NOT screen bloom. Preserve transparency.
prompts.fog: Use case: precise-object-edit. Replace the input broad purple-grey fog bank with a THIN BLUE-BLACK distant-field-edge fog strip. Transparent RGBA horizontal 4:1 canvas, intended 512x128 logical px. Only a thin irregular band between y36 and y64 is occupied; transparent above and below including lower half. Flat deep blue-black smoky silhouettes, 3 dark restrained shades, low soft alpha only along a 2-px edge. Long simple wisps, no detached particles, no grey, no purple, no white, no glow, no haze covering foreground, no text. Match first and last columns for horizontal tiling. The band must feel dark and distant, not a cloudy screen overlay. Crisp chunky pixel clusters.
